scenarios.name: happy-path
scenarios.description: Baseline: the agent finds the right file, makes the change, and the tests pass.

scenarios.name: error-recovery
scenarios.description: read_file on a wrong path fails; the agent lists the folder and recovers.

answerKey.note: The failed read on a wrong path; the agent recovers on its own.

scenarios.name: silent-bad-result
scenarios.description: A search returns the wrong file; the agent edits it; the tests fail much later.

answerKey.note: The search lists src/legacy/filter.ts first. The app imports src/filters/index.ts, so the edits never take effect.

scenarios.name: loop
scenarios.description: The agent runs the same failing build 8 times without changing anything.

answerKey.note: The loop starts at the first repeat: the same command, the same error, and nothing changed in between.

scenarios.name: slow-step
scenarios.description: One test run hangs for 90 s and times out; the agent reruns a narrower set.

answerKey.note: The timed-out test run: 90 s in watch mode.

scenarios.name: subagents
scenarios.description: Three sub-agents run in parallel; one fails and the parent carries on with its bad guess.

answerKey.note: The explore-dates sub-agent failed and guessed 'Unix timestamps'. Due dates are ISO strings, so every comparison is false.

scenarios.name: token-blowup
scenarios.description: Reading a huge seed-data file multiplies the input tokens of every later model call.

answerKey.note: The 2,500-line read stays in context, so every later model call pays for it. The run succeeds but costs far more than it should.

scenarios.name: large-run
scenarios.description: A long run of mixed steps with one failure in the middle, for performance and scroll tests.

answerKey.note: The one failure: a switch to local-time parsing breaks a test; reverted to UTC.

scenarios.name: untimed
scenarios.description: Scenario 3 (silent bad result) with no timestamps, as some trajectory formats have.

answerKey.note: The search lists src/legacy/filter.ts first. The app imports src/filters/index.ts, so the edits never take effect.

scenarios.name: broken-file
scenarios.description: Invalid JSON on one line and a truncated last line. The parser should show a clear error.

answerKey.note: The files are damaged on purpose; see `corruption` in samples/index.json for where.
